entries.rationale: Names the resource and the operation. `virtuals.list` said neither what it lists nor that it screens: it takes chain, status, sortBy, limit, page and pageSize and returns a filtered, ranked, bounded window of agent tokens (manifests/agents.ts:33-55), which is exactly the canonical `discover` verb rather than `list`.
Names the resource; singular for the by-id read, matching the plural discover above.

Adds the missing canonical verb. Mapped 1:1 here, but see the merge proposal in protocol-naming-2.md: the handler is virtuals.list with sort lpCreatedAt plus an AVAILABLE-and-lpCreatedAt predicate over the same projector (handlers.ts:139-178 vs :81-120).

Provider jargon expanded. `geneses` is an unusual plural that carries no meaning for a model scanning the namespace; the tool browses the genesis launch calendar, points-sale events preceding agent-token launches (manifests/agents.ts:93). Kept in the singular-noun-plus-plural-resource form with the canonical verb last.
